subject: MAP & short runway for evaluation kit loan: usage constraints + destruction window
messages:
From: Claudia Santos <claudia.santos@brightretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightretail.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short MAP + ephemeral access to eval artifacts

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for yesterday's demo — the team was really impressed with the latency numbers and the way your routing handled our multi-region traffic. Per our conversation, procurement asked me to put this request in writing so they can start internal approvals.

We want a short mutual action plan (MAP) that covers:
- A 2-week sandbox access window to a prompt pack + 5k test cases (read-only)
- Ephemeral credentials and a destruction/takedown timeline after the sandbox closes
- Usage constraints: no re-distribution, no external benchmarking releases, internal eval only

Attached is a one-page (procurement-mandate) that lists legal contacts and required asset-labeling. Can Redwood provide:
1) A draft MAP and the prompt pack (zipped) with a small sample and a license note;
2) Technical notes on how the data will be hosted (S3 presigned / ephemeral SSO token vs VM image);
3) A statement describing how Redwood will verify deletion 30 days after the window.

If you can get a draft MAP and the package over by end of day Friday (PST), procurement can start the approval path next week.

Best,
Claudia
Head of Data Science
BrightRetail

Attachment: brightretail_request_20260805.pdf (procurement checklist)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Claudia Santos <claudia.santos@brightretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short MAP + ephemeral access to eval artifacts

Hi Claudia — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the procurement checklist.

High level plan:
- We can provision an ephemeral sandbox with a 14-day window. Access will be via short-lived SSO (SAML) credentials; we will not hand over raw S3 keys.
- Prompt pack: we will deliver a zipped package (promptpack_v1) containing the prompts, the mapping file, and a limited set of 500 canonical cases for quick iteration. Full 5k testcases will be staged in the sandbox (read-only).
- Deletion verification: Redwood will execute a documented takedown runbook, provide sha256 manifests before deletion, and share a signed deletion certificate within 7 days of takedown.

Proposed timeline (MAP milestone style):
- Day 0 (today): Draft MAP + prompt pack sample to you (attached).
- Day 2: Procurement questions & legal review; sandbox access provisioned upon MPA countersignature.
- Day 14 from access: Sandbox takedown; deletion certificate delivered by Day 21.

Ben & Karthik are looped in for tech and operational notes — Ben will follow up with details about data masking and logging controls we apply in sandbox.

Action for BrightRetail: please confirm the procurement contact that will sign the MAP and whether the sandbox users should be restricted to an allowlist of emails. Once we have that, I'll route the MAP to legal for a quick review and send the full promptpack.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: MAP-draft-BrightRetail.pdf, redwood_promptpack_v1.zip (sample)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Claudia Santos <claudia.santos@brightretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short MAP + ephemeral access to eval artifacts

Thanks — quick tech notes to keep expectations aligned:

- Sandbox hosting: we'll create a dedicated VPC sandbox in us-west-2 with restricted egress. Artifacts (prompt pack + testcases) will be mounted read-only and served via the Redwood private store; no external downloads are permitted.
- Data handling: we will tokenize any PII-like strings in the promptpack sample and provide the tokenization map internally only. The 5k testcases will be stored with an audit tag and access logs retained for the 14-day window plus 7 days (for audit) — logs will be redacted to remove user email addresses.
- Deletion process: takedown will run a two-pass wipe (object delete + cryptographic shredding of snapshots). We will submit a signed deletion certificate and the sha256 manifest for the final state.

Operational ask: please provide the allowlist and the name/email of the person in procurement who will sign the MAP (we need the signatory for countersignature).

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

Marissa / Ben — this looks good and aligns with procurement's checklist. A few quick confirmations:

1) Signatory for procurement is Ana Morales (ana.morales@brightretail.com). She can countersign the MAP by next Wednesday if we get the draft today.
2) Allowlist: initial users will be the data science team — a short list I will send separately; please restrict to those emails only.
3) Deletion certificate: procurement wants the cert to include a timestamp and the exact manifest we will be deleting to satisfy internal audit. Your outline works.

Next steps: I'll share Ana's details with you and loop procurement on the MAP once I see the final draft. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

—Claudia
